title: Lost in Perception: Isolating Perceptual and Reasoning Failures in Multimodal Physics and Geometry Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.18991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal LLMs report strong performance on scientific reasoning benchmarks, yet most treat perception and reasoning as a single measurable process. We introduce a five-task diagnostic experiment across physics and geometry benchmarks that isolates failures to perception, reasoning, or both. Incorrect diagram interpretation degrades performance even on problems models solve correctly from text alone, and accuracy generally rises from raw images to human-authored captions. Recovery under corrected captions is high for some models, separating perception-blocked failures from genuine reasoning bottlenecks. Which reasoning error follows a perception failure depends on domain: physics failures resolve into calculation errors, geometry into conceptual misapplication. As a discussion beyond our core experiments, InternS1-mini, despite heavy scientific pretraining and thinking capabilities, falls below the weakest model from experiments on ever

translated_title: 迷失于感知：分离多模态物理与几何推理中的感知失败与推理失败
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型在科学推理基准上报告了强劲的性能，但大多数模型将感知和推理视为一个单一的可测量过程。我们引入了一项跨物理和几何基准的五任务诊断实验，将失败原因分离为感知问题、推理问题或两者兼有。错误的图表解读即使在模型仅凭文本就能正确解决的问题上也会降低性能，并且从原始图像到人工编写的图像描述，准确率总体呈上升趋势。在修正后的图像描述下，某些模型的恢复率很高，这有助于将感知受阻导致的失败与真正的推理瓶颈区分开来。感知失败之后出现哪种推理错误取决于领域：物理领域的失败表现为计算错误，几何领域的失败则表现为概念误用。作为核心实验之外的讨论，InternS1-mini 尽管经过了大量科学领域的预训练并具备思考能力，其表现仍低于实验中最弱的模型。
tldr: 本文提出一个五任务诊断实验，将多模态大语言模型在物理与几何推理中的失败分离为感知与推理两类，发现错误的图表解读会损害性能，且感知失败引发的推理错误类型因领域而异——物理中表现为计算错误，几何中表现为概念误用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a five-task diagnostic experiment that isolates perception versus reasoning failures in multimodal LLMs on physics and geometry benchmarks, showing that incorrect diagram interpretation degrades performance and that perception failures lead to different downstream reasoning errors by domain—calculation errors in physics versus conceptual misapplication in geometry.
